name: Monster Girl Dreams
source:
You play as a male adventurer, freshly graduated from the adventuring school, Adventum!
Now you must venture across the home continent of the monster girls, Lucidia, in an attempt to get rich, or get fucked into submission trying. Also defeat the Demon Queen. Maybe.

You can also spend time getting immersed in the games whimsical setting and (usually) upbeat tone as you get to know some of the monster girls.
They might even hold your hand instead of trying to fuck you silly.

Monster Girl Dreams is a RPG that uses a sex and lewd techniques in order to defeat your opponents instead of more conventional forms of battle, all while not trying to give into the enticing pleasures they offer.

[Edited from [url=https://threshold.itch.io/monster-girl-dreams]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是个刚从阿德文图姆冒险学校毕业的男性冒险者！接下来，你得走遍魔物娘的故乡露西迪亚大陆，想办法发大财，搞不好却会先被她们操得服服帖帖。哦，对了，还要打败魔族女王。也许吧。

你也可以放慢脚步，沉浸在游戏异想天开的世界和（通常）轻快的气氛里，好好认识几位魔物娘。说不定她们愿意牵牵你的手，而不是一心想把你操得晕头转向。

在角色扮演游戏《Monster Girl Dreams》里，击败对手靠的是性爱和下流招数，取代了常规的战斗手段。你一边要用这些招数击败对手，一边又得设法抵挡对方送到眼前的诱人快感。
